doc.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Buddy Rich as taskmaster: 'You just play loud'
summary: Rich ran the band like the military and demanded it be tight. He once told the band to play loud while he did the shading.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah he has some great bands and he was a real, you know he ran it like the military, like a Marine or something. He was a real taskmaster. But he demanded that it be tight and really sound good. I remember once he got us aside and he was really mad and yelling at us all. And he called us all kinds of names. “You just play loud and I’ll do the shading,”
that’s what he told us. I’ll never forget that as long as I live. I thought how can we just play loud and he does the shading? But it was great.
